newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - EVEREN lowers Lands' End.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - EVEREN lowers Lands' End.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities said on Friday it lowered its rating on Lands' End Inc stock to intermediate-term market performer from intermediate-term outperformer.
-- Analyst Kevin Silverman said he reduced his rating because the stock had reached a near-term price target of $27.
-- He said he retained the stock's long-term rating as outperformer, and the 18-month price objective remained at $33.
-- "Everything looks terrific but...the stock appears fully valued," he said.
-- Lands' End shares closed Friday 3/8 higher at $27 on the New York Stock Exchange.
